name: Maren TailVent Relaxed Trouser
description: A mid-weight relaxed-fit trouser in heathered charcoal synth-cotton with a reinforced tail port at the rear waistband — a discreet horizontal slit with a finished elastic hem that accommodates tails from whip-thin to moderately thick. The cut is generous through the seat and thighs without looking baggy. Standard pockets, flat front, plain hem.
functionality: Tail port at rear waistband with adjustable elastic hem; accommodates most common tail geneware up to 4cm base diameter
what_it_says: You've got geneware and you're not making a statement about it — just getting dressed and getting on with it.
story_hooks: A character notices the tail port is torn wide — something much larger than a standard tail passed through it recently.
The manufacturer's tag inside the waistband has a second tag sewn over it from a different, unlicensed brand.

physical_description.visual_profile: A slouchy yet intentional silhouette that reads as deliberately comfortable rather than sloppy. The relaxed cut through the hips and thighs creates a gently tapered line down to the ankle. The heathered charcoal gives a muted, lived-in aesthetic that works across corporate and street contexts.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the seat and thighs with a straight leg that tapers slightly at the ankle. Not oversized, but generously cut to accommodate augmentation, movement, and—critically—tail modifications without constraint.
physical_description.primary_material: Mid-weight synth-cotton blend with slight stretch recovery. The synthetic component adds durability and stain resistance while maintaining natural breathability.
physical_description.texture: Soft heathered surface with subtle nubbed texture from the cotton-synthetic weave. Fabric has a matte finish with no sheen, appearing well-broken-in from new.
physical_description.color_scheme: Heathered charcoal gray—a warm, neutral tone that's neither pure black nor industrial silver. Neutral enough to layer with any aesthetic.
physical_description.closures: Flat front with standard button fly and side-seam pockets. The tail port features a discrete horizontal slit reinforced with elastic hem binding at the rear waistband center.
distinctive_features: Reinforced tail port with finished elastic hem at rear waistband
Designed to accommodate tails from subcutaneous implants to moderate bio-mod augmentation
Flat front construction (no pleats, no darts)
Plain finished hem with no cuff or taper details
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional. Not luxury, not salvage—durable working wear designed for people who've invested in augmentation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented workers, street modders, and mixed-heritage populations across the GLMZ who've chosen visible or semi-visible bio-mod. Signals practical adaptation rather than corpo conformity or sub-grade struggle.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually worn broken-in but maintained. Heathered charcoal masks minor wear well. May show creasing at fold points and scuffing at hems from urban movement.

image_prompt: Heathered charcoal relaxed-fit trousers on a lean neo-noir model with visible spinal augmentation ports and a sleek bio-mod tail silhouette, standing in three-quarter profile against a rain-slicked industrial backdrop. Cool neon rim lighting from above. Fabric drapes naturally at ankles. Close detail shot of rear waistband showing subtle reinforced tail port. Dark moody warehouse setting, wet concrete, dim ambient light. --ar 2:3 --v 6
